messages:
mia-logistics: Quick alert: H100 consignment (AWB 112-2334455) is delayed at FRA due to EDI timeouts with the broker. Manifest rejected. Carrier suggests a 20-30h hold for manual processing. Need triage: hold vs split-air for 8 priority units.
atlas-forwarder: Confirmed. Partner EDI gateway had intermittent timeouts causing manifest NACKs. Clearing backlog but manual broker review requested. ETA +20h-30h.
mia-logistics: Any customs paperwork gaps? last-mile stops often from missing tariff classification.
atlas-forwarder: Paperwork complete, but customs flagged a thermal-sample inspection on 5 units. Depot wants photos + serial reconciliation before release.
ryan-procurement: If hold >24h we should consider air-splitting 8 units to DE->UK overnight. Rough uplift estimate?
atlas-forwarder: Estimate ~€82k for 8 H100s next-day FRA->LHR inc. brokerage. Can split AWB but need decision by EOD CET.
lucy-ops: Are the 8 reserved for Dedicated pools or scheduled installs? Teo, will this cause capacity issues?
teo-sre: Those 8 feed two EU-west Dedicated pools and a small on-prem test cluster. A 30h delay will push latency up ~25% and block two customer rollouts. Canary scaling can mitigate but not fully cover SLA exposure.
mia-logistics: Important: if we split, vendor must confirm single RMA chain per serial. We had duplicate RMAs last quarter on split AWBs.
atlas-forwarder: Warranty and RMA follow serial numbers. We'll attach one RMA ref across any split AWBs. Depot photos + signed manifest trigger RMA-2024-119.
rma-bot: RMA created: RMA-2024-119 linked to AWB 112-2334455. Status: awaiting depot photos.
mia-logistics: Uploading serials for the sample set now:

```
serials: [H100-CX9001, H100-CX9002, H100-CX9003, H100-CX9004, H100-CX9005, H100-CX9006, H100-CX9007, H100-CX9008]
```
ryan-procurement: I'll put the €82k uplift in an expedited approval queue. If finance denies, we accept hold and Teo will run canary scale.
teo-sre: Canary ready. I'll pre-warm fallback nodes and update routing policy to route non-critical traffic to US pool if needed. Policy flip ETA 10m.
mia-logistics: Atlas, if EDI outage is on your partner side, can you push for surcharge credit if we still pay air uplift? past vendors issued partial waivers.
atlas-forwarder: Escalating now. Partner accepts responsibility for the outage; they're initiating a surcharge dispute and will seek a partial credit. Cannot promise, will confirm in ~3h.
lucy-ops: Legal note: please capture a signed statement from depot that photo evidence is admissible for insurance/RMA claims. Add to RMA notes.
mia-logistics: Noted and added to RMA-2024-119. Everyone hold for final vendor waiver confirmation; if denied we execute air-split by 18:00 CET to protect rollouts.
